description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Data utilities] Normalises up to 50 URLs offline: lowercases scheme and host, drops default ports, fragments, credentials and known tracking parameters (utm_*, gclid, fbclid, msclkid and similar), then removes duplicates; reports what changed per URL. Input: urls separated by spaces or new lines (or a JSON array via POST). No URL is fetched.
